messages:
maria: heads-up — deploy-bot flagged a high-rate tokenization error in eu-west1 v2.3.4. rolling a hotfix (v2.3.4-hotfix1). requesting expedited approval to skip full canary; impact is increasing 5xx for low-latency endpoints :warning:
release-bot: automated checks: unit tests ✅, smoke tests failed in eu-west1 (tokenizer mismatch). Suggested action: patch, run litmus route (5% traffic), monitor 15m. Logs: https://logs.internal/reproxy/abcd1234
ops-bot: deployment job queued: `deploy service=inference-model region=eu-west1 version=v2.3.4-hotfix1 --strategy=canary --canary=5%`
devon: quick question — what's the rollback plan if litmus shows token misalignment persists? we need explicit conditions (latency, error rate).
sanjay: propose rollback criteria: spike of 5xx > 1% for 5m OR token mismatch rate > 0.2% for 3m. If triggered, immediate pin and roll back to v2.3.3. pinging @oncall-elias for signoff.
leah: need a one-line release note for the customer-facing changelog: suggested: "Fixes rare tokenization mismatch causing generation truncation for some prompt patterns." any tweaks?
oncall-elias: oncall here — agree to expedited path if we keep 5% litmus and 15m hold with telemetry gates. I need the deploy command posted and the rollback button accessible.
maria: copying rollout plan: 1) push v2.3.4-hotfix1 to eu-west1 canary 5% 2) monitor latency & token-match metrics 3) if green after 15m, promote to 50% then 100% over 30m. Rollback criteria per @sanjay.
release-bot: preflight checklist: KMS OK ✅, image signed ✅, infra capacity OK ✅, owner approvals: 0/2 (need 2).
devon: approving now — devon :thumbsup:
sanjay: approving — sanjay :white_check_mark:
leah: posting release note snippet to release-notes draft: "v2.3.4-hotfix1: safety fix for tokenizer mismatch affecting some generation paths."
ops-bot: executing canary deploy: `deploy start job=deploy-2188880000-canary user=maria`
release-bot: canary started at 2188880120. Canary endpoints: https://eu-west1-inference.canary.redwood.internal
ops-bot: litmus route results (5m): error-rate 0.8% -> trending down, token-match failures 0.05%, p95 latency +10ms.
maria: good signal so far. keeping hold for 10 more minutes.
oncall-elias: watching traces. throttling rules temporarily bumped to avoid noisy autoscale during litmus.
devon: if metrics degrade, are we comfortable with an immediate rollback? who hits the button? ops will, correct?
ops-bot: rollback is manual: `deploy rollback job=deploy-2188880000-canary target=v2.3.3` — requires ops engineer to invoke.
sanjay: I will be on standby to execute rollback if thresholds hit.
leah: we've approved release notes and will publish once promoted.
release-bot: canary passed at 2188880480 (15m). promoting to 50% per plan.
ops-bot: promote step started. next promotion scheduled in 20m if stable.
maria: thanks team — expedited approvals granted and rollout proceeding. will update if anything changes. :rocket:
leah: filing changelog entry and sending customer comms draft to #marketing for review.
oncall-elias: thumbs up, staying on call until 100% or rollback.
release-bot: deploy complete at 2188880600. final status: success. all checks green.
maria: closing thread — resolved.
